study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 3,787 patients who underwent induction of labor (IOL) at term
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of successful vaginal delivery for patients with and without SGA fetuses undergoing IOL at term.
mod_finding: This study found that women with small-for-gestational-age fetuses who underwent induction of labor at term were as likely to achieve a vaginal delivery as women with non-small-for-gestational-age fetuses.
